title: Integer Overflow
concept: Use contracts and checked operations to prevent integer overflow — a silent bug that wraps MAX_INT to MIN_INT or vice versa.
why: Integer overflow is silent and catastrophic — it caused the Ariane 5 rocket explosion ($370M loss). Contracts make overflow impossible.
tips: Use checked operations for ALL arithmetic on untrusted input values
The debug runtime traps on overflow — run your tests in debug mode to catch overflow bugs
Consider using wider types (Int64 instead of Int32) if you expect large intermediate values
Wrapping operations (wrapping_add) are useful for hash functions where wrap is intentional
common_mistakes: Assuming debug-mode overflow checks protect release builds — release won't check
Using + on user-supplied integers without overflow consideration
Forgetting that negation of MIN_INT overflows (because abs(MIN_INT) > MAX_INT)
